Evidence-Traceable Perturbational Reasoning for Transposable-Element Regulation

A TE-aware biology knowledge graph with a provable reasoning layer.

Boston Computational Biology Hackathon · Biology knowledge graph track

say: Open with the question, not the architecture. The question is the product.
1/11

Transposable elements are excluded twice over

1 · From the data

Standard RNA-seq pipelines discard multi-mapping reads. TEs are repeated by definition, so the reads that report on them are exactly the reads thrown away.

Most public expression matrices contain no usable TE signal.

2 · From the graph

No major biology knowledge graph has a TE node type.

Hetionet11 node typesno TE
PrimeKG10 node typesno TE
Open Targetstarget / disease / drugno TE

A TE cannot be a target, cannot lie on a path, cannot be predicted — the schema has nowhere to put it.

say: This is the whole pitch. Both exclusions are structural, not accidental. Thirty seconds, then move.
2/11

The tool

INPUTSETDB1
→
OUTPUT
  • signed effect on TE activation — measured where data exists, derived by rule where it does not
  • an evidence tier on every claim
  • a proof tree back to primary sources
  • whether the gene is druggable

Five tiers, enforced in code: curated measured literature inferred predicted. A path takes the tier of its weakest edge.

say: Emphasise: tier is about provenance, not confidence. A high-scoring prediction is still a prediction.
3/11

Built on data nobody had re-quantified

1,114ENCODE knockdown RNA-seq experiments inventoried
570distinct target genes — the substrate for an atlas
3.76 MTE loci, 1,057 subfamilies, from RepeatMasker
2,874graph edges across four independent sources
11samples re-quantified end to end (today)

Pipeline: FASTQ → aligner with -k 100 (keep multi-mappers) → TEcount EM redistribution → PyDESeq2. The -k 100 is the whole trick. Without it there is no TE signal to graph.

say: If asked why only 11 samples: the other 1,049 are a compute question, and the manifest is already built.

say: Say it in this order: I ran known silencers FIRST, because if a known silencer does not derepress its known target then my multi-mapping assignment is broken. TRIM28 AluY padj 0.0005. That is the evidence the method works.
5/11

One measurement propagates to eight unassayed genes

SUV39H1 -SILENCES-> HERV9NC-int        [inferred via R2_WRITER_TRANSFER]
  H3K9me3 -MARK_AT-> HERV9NC-int       [inferred via R1_MARK_GROUNDING]
    SETDB1 -SILENCES-> HERV9NC-int     [measured: ENCODE ENCSR819PCU]
    SETDB1 -DEPOSITS_MARK-> H3K9me3    [curated: GO:0140949]
  SUV39H1 -DEPOSITS_MARK-> H3K9me3     [curated: GO:0140949]

71 derived edges from 5 rules. Every one carries a tree like this.

say: Walk the proof bottom-up. Measured SETDB1 effect + GO says SETDB1 writes H3K9me3, therefore H3K9me3 silences that TE. GO says SUV39H1 also writes it, therefore SUV39H1 should too. Nobody measured SUV39H1. And erasers get the OPPOSITE sign.
6/11

The neurosymbolic part is a citation gate

Symbolic

5 forward-chaining rules over the graph. Every derived edge keeps a proof tree. You can always ask why and get a finite, checkable answer.

Neural

Language models extract relations from abstracts and write the explanation. Neither is trusted.

The coupling: prose is split into sentences; a sentence survives only if every edge ID it cites exists in the graph. Sentences citing nothing are rejected too — silence about provenance is not better than a wrong citation, because the reader cannot tell them apart.

The gate is a string comparison. It runs identically on model-written and template-written text, so the guarantee does not depend on the model behaving.

say: Most LLM+KG systems ask you to trust the model. This one asks you to trust a string comparison.
7/11

Ask it about TET2 — and it refuses

$ python te_reason.py TET2

=== TET2  [best tier: none]  measured=0 curated=0 literature=0 inferred=0
No evidence in the graph connects TET2 to transposable-element activation.
  citation gate: 0 sentences kept, 1 rejected

Why TET2 is hard: no GO transposition annotation, no ENCODE knockdown. Its only route in is the 5mC mark layer — DNMT3A writes 5mC, TET2 erases it, so the rules would give them opposite signs. Grounding 5mC needs a measured DNMT1 effect, and at subset depth DNMT1 gave padj 0.41.

That is a concrete, stated prediction about what full-depth compute buys — not a vague promise of “more data”.

say: This is the strongest 30 seconds in the deck. A tool that refuses to invent an answer, and can name exactly what would fix it.

druggability class (Open Targets + ChEMBL)n
1 · approved drug exists7
2 · clinical-stage6
3 · structurally tractable, no clinical programme 28
4 · druggable family / antibody-accessible only 4

SETDB1, SUV39H1/2, SETDB2, EHMT1, the whole KDM4 family, cGAS, TBK1, IFIH1 — all class 3. Structure exists, no programme does.

say: This is the punchline for the target-discovery framing. Every gene the engine implicates in HERV control is orange: you can make a molecule, nobody has run a programme.

Direction agreement at chance. Sentence co-occurrence is not evidence of a directed claim. Not shipped.

Link prediction

Planned, and gated at plan time on having a gene × TE matrix big enough to hold out a validation set.

Three knockdowns is not. An unvalidated AUC is worse than no model — a judge cannot tell it from noise. Deferred.

Reporting what failed is the trust mechanism working, not a gap in the demo.

say: If challenged on rigour, this is the slide. Most demos show only what worked.
10/11

Honest state, and what is next

Works on real data

  • schema with TE as a first-class node type
  • pipeline validated end to end, 11/11 samples
  • known biology recovered, not hard-coded
  • rule layer with auditable proofs
  • citation gate independent of the model

Not yet true

  • three genes measured, not 570 — “any gene” is architectural
  • two chromosomes, 1.5 M reads
  • one cell line (K562)
  • STAR vs HISAT2 never compared head to head
  • TE → interferon arm drawn, not measured

The thing between this and an actual atlas is compute, not design. The manifest for 1,060 experiments is already built.

say: Land on this. Do not oversell. The architectural claim is defensible; the coverage claim is not, and saying so is what makes the rest credible.
11/11
